entries.name: Bridge to Nowhere

facts.claim: The current ticketUrl (the park page) fails the title check: its title is "Whanganui National Park: Places to go in Manawatu/Whanganui". DOC has a page that names the place: "Bridge to Nowhere Walk: Whanganui National Park, Whanganui region".

DOC: 3 km return, 1 hr 30 min; jetboat needed to the Mangapurua Landing (then a 40 min walk) or reached on foot by the Mangapurua Track from Whakahoro/Ruatiti; bridge built mid-1930s for the Mangapurua Valley soldier settlement.

Visit Ruapehu lists the Whanganui River Adventures Bridge to Nowhere tour at adult $205 (child $103); a search snippet cites Bridge to Nowhere Tours at adult $190. The data has 150-200: change to 190-205.

entries.ticketUrl_note: DOC page loaded OK and its title names the walk. Sold by many operators, so DOC (the managing agency) is the right single link.
unverified: $190 for Bridge to Nowhere Tours comes from a search snippet, not a loaded page.
Operator prices vary by season/add-ons.
